    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(len(grid)) for c in range(len(grid[0])) if grid[r][c]==obj]
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); r1=max(r for r,c in pts)

    g=[[v for v in row] for row in grid]
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):
